## Issues and fixes

- The initial responsive modal retained a 106-pixel movie-row pitch after shrinking to title-only content. The fetched upstream fix replaces the fixed-height arranger when the responsive level changes, clearing stale measurements. The latest Wasm build passed repeated grow/shrink cycles with the compact 27-pixel pitch restored.
- Website preparation exposed an unnecessary relink on every pthread Wasm incremental build: the shared make recipe required `app.worker.js` even when Emscripten 3.1.69 generated module workers. Updated `<Tools repo>/Ubuntu/vl/makefile-cpp` to require the separate worker only when `app.mjs` references it, corrected the SDK-layout guidance, and propagated the recipe with `vgo uci`. A subsequent real FCT `-bw -o` completed without compilation or linking. Five isolated build-wrapper inventory checks passed: complete module/separate-worker layouts stay unchanged; missing referenced worker, module or binary triggers repair. These fixture checks do not claim an older SDK runtime run. Evidence: `<GacJS repo>/build/rpwasm-20261116/fct-incremental.log`, `<GacJS repo>/build/rpwasm-20261116/incremental-result.json`.
- Corrected the Wasm read-only regression's selected-text readback to use protocol run fields `caretBegin`/`caretEnd`. Its old nonexistent `begin`/`end` fields could report the whole marker for a partial highlight. GacJS build/all 11 package test targets and the real Wasm read-only regression passed with the corrected assertion.
- Firefox RVMT's Unicode failure came from obsolete synthetic `KeyboardEvent` text injection. The active browser adapter consumes browser text-input events. A fresh Firefox probe passed exact `Hello, FirefoxRPC你好🙂!` through `keyboard.insertText`; updated the regression to use that browser input path. All three Firefox app regressions passed afterward.
